summary: Tested refactored Caja module (backend/routes/caja.py). Ran pytest suite (17 tests) + Playwright UI smoke test. CRITICAL: All POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints in caja.py return 500 due to broken FastAPI dependency injection. GET endpoints work and frontend loads correctly showing the 3 tabs, but write operations from the UI would fail once user tries them. 6/17 backend tests pass (all GETs). Frontend renders Caja Diaria (Estado Abierta, Q625/Q50/Q775), CxC tab, and Cierres Financieros tab correctly.

critical.issue: TypeError: 'function' object is not subscriptable at current_user['id']. Root cause: routes/caja.py uses Depends(lambda: get_current_user) — the lambda returns the function REFERENCE instead of invoking the FastAPI dependency. Same pattern used ~40+ times for get_current_user, require_permission, require_role. Confirmed via /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log traceback pointing to /app/backend/routes/caja.py:836 (crear_cierre_financiero) and reproduced for /caja/movimientos POST, /catalogos/pagadores POST, /cxc POST, /cierres-financieros POST.
Backend exposes /abono (singular) while previous test iteration noted frontend may call /abonos (plural). Verify frontend path matches backend.

Same wrapper pattern needed for require_permission(perm) and require_role(role) (they are factory functions returning a dependency). rca of the issue: In /app/backend/routes/caja.py, the module-level `get_current_user`, `require_permission`, `require_role` are None at import time and are assigned by init_caja_routes(). To defer resolution, the developer used `Depends(lambda: get_current_user)`. BUT this lambda takes no args and returns the function reference itself — it does NOT invoke it. FastAPI stores the lambda's return value as `current_user`, so `current_user` ends up being the function object, and any `current_user['id']` raises TypeError: 'function' object is not subscriptable. Mitigation: define proper async wrapper deps that call the injected globals with the correct FastAPI-managed arguments (HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)).
